initiative: Rotating local and emerging designers, twice-yearly resets
what_happened: Inventory and displays reset twice a year. Local and emerging designers appear in rotating displays, and each brand controls its own space.
New York receives the same weekly drops from Supreme and Nike Lab as those brands' own stores, plus frequent capsule collections and collaborations.
